description: trivago hotel prices for a destination: the hotels trivago lists for a city search (usually ~35) with name, location note, lowest price shown per night, guest rating out of 10 with review count, stars and trivago URL, plus trivago's destination price facts (typical nightly range, cheapest and most expensive month). Prices are in the currency trivago picks for the visitor region (reported in the output); not a dated availability search. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
